presentation.label: 255 Kits per project
presentation.summary: 255 Kits per project instead of four Parts per bank: each pattern plays its own Kit, saved and loaded by name.
presentation.overview: A Kit is a saved Part with a name: machines, samples by slot, effects, track and MIDI settings, LFOs and the 16 scenes. Kits keeps 255 of them per project and lets each pattern play its own, so patterns are no longer tied to their bank's four Parts. Press PART to load a Kit into the current pattern, FUNC+PART to save the current Part as a Kit. Behind the scenes each pattern's Kit is copied into a free Part slot of its bank before the pattern plays, through the stock Part engine.
highlights: LOAD KIT and SAVE KIT lists with the Kits' names, UNDO KIT, and seven-character names.
Each pattern plays its Kit; copying and pasting a pattern carries its Kit.
Copy, paste and clear Kits in the list; FUNC+CUE reloads the pattern's Kit as saved.
Projects without Kits are migrated: each stock Part becomes a Kit and its patterns keep playing it.
usage: Press PART (MKI: FUNC+MIDI): LOAD KIT lists UNDO KIT and the 255 Kits. Choose one with YES: the current pattern plays it now.
Press FUNC+PART (MKI: FUNC+MIDI, then FUNC+BANK): SAVE KIT. Choose a Kit with YES, name it and confirm: the current Part is saved into it and the pattern plays it.
The status line shows the current pattern's Kit as NNN name.

access.location: PART (MKII) or FUNC+MIDI (MKI) from any page
steps: Press PART on the MKII, or FUNC+MIDI on the MKI, to open LOAD KIT.
Move to a Kit with UP and DOWN or the LEVEL encoder and press YES: the current pattern plays that Kit.
Press FUNC+PART on the MKII, or FUNC+MIDI then FUNC+BANK on the MKI, to open SAVE KIT; press YES on a Kit, edit its name and confirm to save the current Part into it.

limitations: OS 1.40C on the Modwerk base with the sample-memory loan (ot_sample_memory), over USB only: card firmware cannot include it. Not yet run on a unit or in the emulator.
Borrows 331 pages (about 2 MB) of sample memory while installed: about 23 s less of 16-bit mono sample time. When the pool cannot spare them, Kits stays off and the unit behaves as stock.
FUNC+PART opens SAVE KIT, so the stock Part Edit window and the rows other modules add there cannot be opened while Kits is installed.
No quick save with FUNC+YES in SAVE KIT: save with YES and the name editor. FUNC+YES in either list does what it does elsewhere.
A Kit carries no MIDI scene locks, and a kits.work from an octabam image with MIDI SCENES (version 2) is not read: that project then plays its Parts as stock.
A damaged kits.work is never overwritten: that project then plays its Parts as stock and keeps no Kits. Rename or delete the file on the card to start over.
Keep Kits installed while you save, reload or copy a project that uses it: without it, kits.work is not saved or reloaded with the project.
The first time Kits reads a project without kits.work it writes one (1.6 MB): installing Kits into a running project does this at once.
Not offered with Pattern Sample Locks: Kits' SAVE KIT takes FUNC+PART, the Part edit menu Pattern Sample Locks adds its rows to.

resources.recorded: 16 November 2026; from the assembled unit, unmeasured on a unit

storage.label: Storage
storage.display: 10.5 KB code, 38 KB buffers, 2 MB borrowed sample memory; kits.work 1.6 MB a project
storage.conditions: m68k-elf-size of kits.s: 10,548 bytes of code, 196 of data, 38,968 of bss. Sample memory: 331 pages of 6,144 bytes for the library (1,622,944 bytes) and the edit pool (405,632 bytes). Battery RAM: 72 bytes at 0x100f85a0 and 256 at 0x100fbf00.

processing.label: ColdFire
processing.conditions: Work happens when a pattern is requested or chained (a Kit copied into a slot: up to four Part compares and two Part copies), at LOAD KIT, SAVE KIT and the list operations, and at a project load or save (kits.work is read or written whole). Nothing on the DSP.

impact.conditions: Pattern changes while playing; project loads and saves.

cpu.rationale: Work happens at pattern requests and panel actions, not per sample or per step; not measured.

memory.rationale: About 2 MB of the sample memory while installed, and about 49 KB of the module memory all modules share.

tests.summary: Assembled and packaged only. No install, gesture, save, reload or power cycle tested on a unit or in the emulator.

license.declaration: Sam Banks' MIT module from octabam with Modwerk's port changes, MIT; after Em's Octakit design (MIT). Stock sites are named by address, length and SHA-256 only. No firmware, extracted stock code or built images are included.
